name: Bone Sweet Bone

faq.answer: Sun-bleached bones are needed to rebuild nests for the scavengers driven away by the undead blight.
By feeding on carcasses, these winged creatures break down remains and return vital nutrients to the soil, paving the way for new life.
faq.q: How do these scavengers help the land?

faq.answer: The presence of the undead drove off the roosting broods and upset the natural rhythm of the land.
faq.q: What disrupted the nests in the first place?

sections.body: The walking dead have disrupted nature's quiet cycle here, driving away the scavengers whose feeding returns vital nourishment to the dirt. A winged guardian needs twenty sun-bleached bones to reconstruct dwellings for its scattered brood. Once the blight lifts and the roosts stand whole again, these creatures can return to their essential feast.
sections.title: Nests in the Blight

summary: A winged patron seeks to restore balance to soil ruined by the undead blight. While you travel among the fallen, you are asked to gather sun-bleached bones to rebuild roosts for creatures that enrich the earth.
